clinical_trials.title: Does Oral Isotretinoin Increase the Risk of Developing Infection With and Complications From Covid-19, Compared to an Age-matched Background Population

literature.title: Ethnic Differences of Palmoplantar Pustulosis: A Systematic Review.
literature.abstract: Ethnic differences in the clinical and molecular features of many immune-mediated dermatoses have been reported, including psoriasis vulgaris and generalized pustular psoriasis. Palmoplantar pustulosis (PPP) is a chronic and relapsing inflammatory skin disease manifesting as crops of sterile pustules over an erythematous base on the palms and soles. To date, ethnic differences in PPP have been rarely studied.

literature.abstract: The marked efficacy of isotretinoin in the treatment of acne is undoubtedly due to its potential to inhibit sebaceous gland activity. The question arises if the anti-acne effect of new oral retinoids can be predicted by using the currently available experimental models.

literature.title: Consensus on the use of oral isotretinoin in dermatology - Brazilian Society of Dermatology.
literature.abstract: Isotretinoin is a synthetic retinoid, derived from vitamin A, with multiple mechanisms of action and highly effective in the treatment of acne, despite common adverse events, manageable and dose-dependent. literature.abstract: Hidradenitis suppurativa is a common debilitating skin disease that has been neglected by science. literature.title: The effect of oral isotretinoin on visual contrast sensitivity and amount of lacrimation in patients with acne vulgaris.
literature.abstract: Acne vulgaris is a puberty-onset chronic inflammatory disease of the pilosebaceous unit. Isotretinoin is a derivative of vitamin A commonly used for severe and nodulocystic acne. While isotretinoin has many side effects related to the eye, visual system and lacrimation, there is no information regarding isotretinoin's influence on contrast sensitivity.

literature.title: Long-term results of acitretin therapy for hidradenitis suppurativa. Is acne inversa also a misnomer?
literature.abstract: Hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) is a distressing chronic inflammatory skin disorder which affects predominantly the groins and axillae. In analogy to acne, oral isotretinoin has been considered in the treatment of HS, although there are strong indications that this drug has only a very limited therapeutic effect. During the past 25 years scattered case reports have described promising results of treatment with acitretin.

literature.title: Skin metabolism established with the use of MetaSite for selected retinoids employed in topical and systemic treatment of various skin disorders and found in cosmeceuticals.
literature.abstract: Besides being widely used in cosmetics, retinoids are potent therapeutic agents used topically and systemically as anti-acne agents. The aim of this study was to predict with the use of MetaSite the skin metabolism of selected retinoids employed in treatment of skin disorders and found in cosmeceuticals. The following compounds were studied: retinol, retinaldehyde, retinoic acid, retinyl acetate, retinyl palmitate, acitretin, etretinate, adapalene and bexarotene.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Acitretin 透過 RAR 活化抑制皮脂腺活性並調節濾泡角化，理論上可減少粉刺形成。然而，在痤瘡治療中，同類藥物 Isotretinoin（13-cis retinoic acid）因對皮脂腺具更強選擇性，為已核准標準療法；Acitretin 對皮脂腺的直接效果顯著弱於 Isotretinoin，故機轉存在但非最優路徑。現有文獻多指向 acne inversa（hidradenitis suppurativa，HS）而非典型 acne vulgaris，兩者需明確區分。
Retinoids 具有免疫調節作用，可調控 Th17/Treg 平衡，理論上對自體免疫疾病有潛在相關性。然而，Acitretin 對 SLE 的致病機轉（免疫複合體沉積、補體活化、Type I IFN pathway）無明確干預靶點。兒科族群安全性資料極為有限，且 pSLE 治療已有標準方案（Hydroxychloroquine, Steroids, MMF 等）。
胎兒紅母細胞症（Rh 或 ABO 血型不相容引起的溶血性疾病）與 Acitretin 作用機轉完全無交集。Acitretin 為 Pregnancy Category X 藥物，具明確致畸胎性（中軸骨骼、顱面、心臟缺陷），在妊娠相關情境中使用屬絕對禁忌。此適應症存在根本性安全禁忌，不得進一步評估。

predicted_indications.disease_name: familial cutaneous telangiectasia and oropharyngeal predisposition cancer syndrome

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 此罕見癌症易感症候群（可能涉及 TELANGIECTASIA 相關基因）與 Acitretin 之間無已知分子靶點連結。Retinoids 雖有化學預防潛力（透過 RAR 調控細胞分化與凋亡），但針對此特定遺傳症候群無任何前臨床或臨床研究。
補體 C4a 缺乏為免疫缺陷相關疾病，主要影響補體系統第二路徑。Acitretin 作用靶點為 RAR 核受體，不直接調控補體蛋白合成或功能。兩者無已知交集。
細菌性心內膜炎為感染性疾病，標準治療為抗生素（及外科手術）。Acitretin 無抗菌活性，且不影響心臟瓣膜生物膜形成或細菌毒力因子的相關通路。此預測明顯缺乏生物合理性，判斷為知識圖譜關聯雜訊。
家族性黑棘皮症多由 FGFR2/FGFR3 活化突變或胰島素抵抗導致角質細胞過度增殖。Acitretin 透過 RAR 抑制角質細胞增殖並促進正常分化，機轉上具有相當合理性。類視色素類藥物（包括局部 retinoids）已在其他角化疾病有效，但針對家族性黑棘皮症尚無臨床資料。
淚腺脫垂為結構性/解剖性眼眶疾患，主要病因為眼眶筋膜支持組織鬆弛。此為機械性問題，標準治療為外科修復。Acitretin 的 RAR 作用機轉對結締組織支撐功能無直接效用，缺乏生物合理性。
家族性局限性熱誘導蕁麻疹為罕見遺傳性肥大細胞活化疾病，主要機轉為溫度刺激觸發組織胺釋放。Acitretin 的 RAR 信號通路與肥大細胞脫顆粒機轉無直接關聯。雖 Retinoids 可調節皮膚免疫反應，但對此特定遺傳性蕁麻疹亞型無已知療效證據。

literature.abstract: Sjögren-Larsson syndrome (SLS) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder with worldwide distribution. It consists of ichthyosis, spastic diplegia and mental retardation caused by an enzymatic defect in fatty alcohol oxidation.
